ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: Got a number? Now, which one do you trust with your house keys?
Number one? He won't even look at you.
Number two? He can't stop smiling.
And number four looks sorry. For what?
You've got one second. Pick him.
That's one killer, and one man you trust with your house.
Look at the gap in his eyebrow. It's in all four photos.
lines.text_kokoro: Look at the gap in his eyebrow. It's in all four [photos](/fˈOtOz/).

lines.text: You stared at it for twenty-four seconds.
A tenth of a second is all it takes, and then I handed you four reasons.
You never judged him. You judged a photo.
lines.text_kokoro: You never judged him. You judged a [photo](/fˈOtO/).

lines.text: And he's still got your keys.
